back.es: guard (a person who guards, e.g. a security, prison or palace guard)
back.example: The guard didn't let us in.

note: Guardia used for a person can be masculine or feminine (el guardia / la guardia, a woman guard), and la guardia also means a guard duty or a guard unit, as in estar de guardia; the editor could say this in the grammar, and a hint like "the person, e.g. at a gate or prison" would steer learners away from vigilante a little better than "on watch".
